name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Nereo Valeriano: model routing for prompts and subagents, and a where-am-i card with suggested next steps.

plugins.name: auto-model
plugins.description: Picks the model for each prompt and each subagent (never above /model and /effort for prompts), with Jev, OpenAI or Claude as the picker, and shows a colored bar under the input: model, effort, context, 7-day limit and agents. /auto-model on|off, /route for subagents. Subagent picking is ported from Hamza Zafar's switchboard (MIT).

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt as one card: the goal as its title; now, waiting on you and next with their status; and suggested next prompts in the same box (on by default, off in /config). /where for a longer one.
